en.headline: 90.4% of Wang Fuk Court owners have signed sale agreements
en.dek: Housing secretary Winnie Ho said the figure was as of 30 September, with signing due by 15 October.
body: Secretary for Housing Winnie Ho said that as of 30 September, 90.4 per cent of Wang Fuk Court owners had completed signing sale and purchase agreements, RTHK reported on Friday.

Ho said owners must finish signing by 15 October. A cross-departmental briefing team would continue to support residents through the flat-selection process under the special sales scheme, she said on social media.

The scheme was set up for owners of the Tai Po estate after the fire there. Ho said the longer-term housing arrangements were meant to give owners a home-ownership option, and that the briefing team had been running viewing tours and information sessions.

zh.headline: 截至9月30日 宏福苑90.4%業主已簽買賣協議
zh.dek: 房屋局局長何永賢表示，業主須於10月15日或之前完成簽署，解說專隊會繼續支援揀樓。
body: 香港電台周五報道，房屋局局長何永賢表示，截至9月30日，有90.4%宏福苑業主已完成簽署《買賣協議》。
何永賢在社交網頁表示，業主須於10月15日或之前完成簽署。政府跨部門「解說專隊」會在特設銷售計劃的揀樓過程中，繼續全力支援居民。
特設銷售計劃是因應大埔宏福苑火災而設。何永賢說，長遠居住安排旨在為業主提供置業方案，解說專隊一直透過睇樓團和講座講解資訊。
